constructedRouteBuilders.why: the data layer's storage backend predates the transport and composes `${base}/store/${ns}/${key}` against an injected fetch. It encodes both segments, so it is correct, but it does not go through rea-transport.js — recorded by the data layer CORE as a converge-later item. Until it converges, its four paths cannot be found by the literal scan, so it is declared here.
constructedRouteBuilders.convergeTo: callRoute(transport, 'getStoreByNamespaceByKey', {params}) once the KV backend takes the transport; the KV list route is one of the six conditional ones and would then win a 304 it does not ask for today.

constructedRouteBuilders.why: The two TEMPLATED socket channels take their id from the caller, so `sensorSnapshotPath()` and `pluginEndpointPath()` compose `${WS_PREFIX}/sensors/${id}/snapshot` and `${WS_PREFIX}/plugins/${id}/${endpoint}`. Both interpolate through encodeURIComponent and both templates are socket rows in this table.

reaPath/reaQuery/socketUrl compose the base URL with a path handed to them. It builds no route of its own — the path always arrives from the caller or from the generated table — so it declares no rows.
buildPath fills `<param>` placeholders from the generated table's own template. The template is the row; nothing is invented at the call site.

loggedIn:false NO LONGER MEANS 'not linked'. Since the pin move it also covers 'linked, but decentespresso.com could not be reached', 'linked, but the reply was neither an acceptance nor a rejection', and 'linked, but the last check was indeterminate and we are inside the 30 s cooldown' (decent_account_service.dart:488-499, :504-507, :509-554). Do not word a signed-out state as 'no account' on the strength of this route alone, and do not treat the first call of a session as cheap: it can block on an HTTP round trip that carries no deadline and no abort (_authedGet takes the untimed `_httpClient.get` branch at :708-711 on this path).
